subject.title: fix(ci): persist warm runtime caches across runs

question: Should this protected CI-automation change proceed only after the workflow-dispatch release-gate ref is repaired and a later independent cache restore is demonstrated?
rationale: The maintainer label requires explicit handling for a workflow change that affects release-gate execution and CI cache lifecycle; contributor-side proof cannot establish the protected workflow result without maintainer review.

options.title: Repair and re-prove before merge
options.body: Populate the dispatch release-gate ref, rebase, and provide redacted writer-to-later-restorer workflow evidence before reviewing the refreshed head.

options.title: Pause the cache migration
options.body: Close or defer this branch if the repository does not want to accept the operational cache-topology change now.

recommendation.title: Repair and re-prove before merge
recommendation.body: Populate the dispatch release-gate ref, rebase, and provide redacted writer-to-later-restorer workflow evidence before reviewing the refreshed head.
